picks.editorial_note: A $53M ARPA-H award is one of the largest single grants in this week's pool, and pairs federal funding with generative AI drug/compound-discovery methods aimed at a concrete agricultural problem.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifying simulation of wildly different physical phenomena (sand, proteins) in one architecture is a genuine methodological breakthrough with broad downstream applications in materials science and biology.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: An independent AI-based confirmation of the iconic Event Horizon Telescope black hole image, published in Nature, strengthens one of the most consequential results in modern astrophysics using a novel machine-learning validation technique.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Carnegie Mellon's new 'Workspace Models' memory approach addresses a core bottleneck in robot learning — letting robots recall past observations cheaply — with direct implications for practical embodied AI.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: A multi-institution Japanese collaboration's lightweight language-model approach to predicting material properties could meaningfully speed up materials discovery pipelines that are normally computationally expensive.
picks.title: 言語モデルを用いた材料物性の予測を軽量化 | Science Tokyo - 東京科学大学

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, anchored to a planned joint lab, exemplifies the deepening academia-industry pipeline in embodied AI and signals significant Hong Kong investment in robotics talent and infrastructure.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize sovereign AI research (physical AI, agentic AI, cybersecurity) reflects a national push for European AI industrial independence.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: SMU's $4.2M NIST award to build a Digital Twin Technology Lab ties AI and HPC directly to semiconductor manufacturing workforce development, a strategically important industrial sector.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training

picks.editorial_note: A $5M NSF multi-institutional grant led by the University of Georgia to build an open experimental wireless network for extended reality shows sustained federal investment in AI-adjacent next-generation infrastructure.
picks.title: $5M NSF grant to grow extended reality technologies

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern's analysis of the Nvidia CEO espionage-linked scandal raises serious national security questions about the leadership of the company at the center of the global AI hardware supply chain.
picks.title: Nvidia CEO’s scandal raises questions about US national security
